dedupe_keys.name: jaxa echla soil moisture and vegetation water content

description: JAXA publishes the ECHLA land reanalysis, made with a land and vegetation assimilation system developed at the University of Tokyo. It combines AMSR-E and AMSR2 microwave observations with a model to provide daily soil moisture at five depth bands from 0 to 195 cm, vegetation water content and leaf-area index. The snow-free global land product uses a 0.25-degree grid and NetCDF-4. Its public landing gives 2002–2011 and 2012–2021 periods with a gap between satellites. The product is free, but JAXA requires registration and agreement with its distribution terms before downloading files; no standard open licence was stated on the inspected page. Soil and vegetation water states can inform runoff, irrigation and drought simulations. The grid cannot resolve field-scale soil differences, and the satellite gap must remain missing. It complements data-isric-soilgrids-global-soil-maps with time-varying water states, not static soil properties. No NetCDF file was downloaded.
